name: The Dread Citadel Manifests: Malgakor the Despoiled Awakes at (4,0)

cycle_advancement.world_state: Chaos God-Lord Citadel Active at (4,0) — Reality Bleed Ongoing

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The subterranean abyss at (4,0) has erupted in blinding violet warp-fire. A mile-high brass ziggurat pulsates with weeping eye-sigils. Lord Malgakor the Despoiled (Chaos Lord / Demigod) sits upon a throne of screaming skulls, projecting an unholy plague aura across the southern underhive.

Sergeant Kathryn Vane stands awake and fully restored upon the high balcony of Saint Katherine's Basilica. Through the smog, the ominous violet warp-flare of the Chaos Citadel at (4,0) paints the toxic clouds.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Blighted Eye of Lord Malgakor
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: A god-like Chaos Lord—Malgakor the Despoiled (650 HP, 80% Unholy Warp-Shielding, 50 Retaliation)—has planted his dread citadel at (4,0). The fortress constantly emanates necrotic contagion and warp-dissonance, corrupting the air and threatening the entire sub-level.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Confront a literal Chaos God-Champion in his throne-citadel. Break his daemonic warp-shields with concentrated archeotech plasma and holy relics, or endure eternal biological and spiritual decay.

active_combat_encounters.boss_name: Lord Malgakor the Despoiled, Scourge of Tartarus
active_combat_encounters.threat_rating: Divine / Demigod Apex (Chaos Lord of the Warp)
active_combat_encounters.armor_status: Unholy Daemonic Aegis & Terminator Plate (80% Damage Reduction against all non-Plasma/Power attacks)
active_combat_encounters.tactical_requirements: Requires Mark IV Archeotech Plasma weaponry, Bone 'ead Bragg's Power Fist, and the Kastelan Automaton's heavy phosphor bombardment to breach the daemonic warp-shield before the Chaos Lord can be wounded.
active_combat_encounters.failure_consequences: Total spiritual corruption and slaughter of Sub-Level 404, transforming the hive canyon into a daemon world.

new_decision.decision: Awoke from restful slumber in the Basilica to the blaring alarms of the auspex-net: observed the dark warp-eruption at (4,0), identifying the dread citadel of Chaos Lord Malgakor the Despoiled, a literal god-champion of the Ruinous Powers plaguing the sector.
new_decision.impact: Rallied the garrison, ordered the Kastelan Automaton, Bragg, and Jax to ready the newly looted Archeotech Plasma weaponry for an apocalyptic offensive.
